metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the C++20 `iges` CLI in [output/](/workspace/output/README.md), with all five commands and no third-party dependencies. From that directory, it builds and passes the included integration test with:

```sh
cmake -B build && cmake --build build
ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
```

Generated fixtures also exercised all 87 catalog type codes, form-dependent records, delimiter handling, round-trip stability, and curve and surface evaluations.

**Full lossless IGES support remains incomplete.** Some Type 402 associativity forms are not faithfully modeled, and the supplied specification transcription omits the details needed to verify Type 322 fully. Boolean Property values also lose their boolean tag after writing and parsing because their wire encoding is indistinguishable from integer `0` or `1`. Trailing entity parameters are preserved using an `extra_parameters` JSON extension.

No real CAD files were available for verification, and fetching public fixtures was blocked, so real-world round-trip compatibility remains unverified.

editorial.last_message: Claims a dependency-free C++20 iges CLI (output/, README) with all five commands whose build and included integration test pass, with generated fixtures covering all 87 type codes, form-dependent records, delimiters, round-trip stability and evaluation. States full lossless IGES support is incomplete: some Type 402 forms are not faithfully modeled, Type 322 could not be fully verified, Boolean properties lose their tag on round trip, and trailing parameters are kept in an extra_parameters extension. Says real-world compatibility is unverified because no CAD files were available and fetching public fixtures was blocked. Acknowledged limits; not a false completion claim.
